campaign: RSCD v1.5 Skeptical Review & Remediation — Block G1 (SI-1 ALFRED vintage pinning)
purpose: Record, per series x FRED-id, the retrieval date of the data CURRENTLY SHIPPED plus the ALFRED realtime vintage date to pin so a future refresh can reproduce the shipped figures byte-for-byte. This manifest + code/utils/vintage_manifest.py helper + remediation_campaign/scripts/check_vintage_manifest.py coverage check IS the Phase-N deliverable. Migrating loaders to fetch from ALFRED at the pinned realtime date (rather than live FRED) is a documented FOLLOW-UP; loaders are NOT rewritten in this pass (that would change data).
pin_realtime_date_note: ALFRED realtime_start/realtime_end to pass on the follow-up migration so each series resolves to the vintage current on this date. Retrieval dates below (from data/raw/api_cache/*/*.meta.json fetched_at) predate this pin; the pin is the reproducibility anchor going forward.

vintage_policy_vocabulary.pin_alfred_realtime: Genuinely unpinned live-FRED extension (SI-1 sweep candidate). Pin the ALFRED vintage as-of pin_realtime_date to reproduce; follow-up = ALFRED fetch migration.
vintage_policy_vocabulary.pin_alfred_realtime_proxy: Same, but the FRED id is an explicit PROXY (documented in the series EPR / decision) — pinning reproduces the proxy, it does not upgrade it to a native source.
vintage_policy_vocabulary.pin_alfred_realtime_secondary_overlay: FRED is a secondary overlay; the shipped primary data comes from another source (e.g. MeasuringWorth per Decision 0008). Pin the FRED overlay for reproducibility.
vintage_policy_vocabulary.pin_alfred_realtime_tail_extension: Live-FRED tail extension not in the SI-1 priority list; included here for COMPLETE coverage of all live-FRED loaders. Same pin policy.
vintage_policy_vocabulary.salvaged_baked_no_live_fetch: No live FRED fetch — the extension is baked into a salvaged/CD2-preserved column. Excluded from ALFRED pinning by nature; recorded for completeness.

follow_up_status.summary: All 15 live-FRED loaders migrated to the shared ALFRED pinned-fetch path (S00_apis.fred_observations with realtime_start=realtime_end=<pin>, resolved via utils.vintage_manifest.realtime_window). Ch10 extension loaders (S1002/S1003/S1005/S1006/S502) switched from the un-pinnable fredgraph.csv transport to native-frequency ALFRED JSON (client-side annual aggregation unchanged).
follow_up_status.pin_semantics: alfred_realtime_pin now equals each fred_id retrieval_date (the vintage AND observation-release window of the shipped fetch). ALFRED realtime_end gates which partial-year months are published, so pinning to the campaign anchor 2026-07-02 (rather than the shipped retrieval date) would pull extra 2026 partial-year months and change partial-year averages. Pin=retrieval_date reproduces the shipped chopped byte-for-byte.
